# WB10 · Hôm nay · Bác sĩ

Group **WB · Vận hành: tổng quan, hôm nay, lịch** · state · Next.js: **restyle (U1)** (`/today`) · account `doctor-mai`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#today`
- Operations pages are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (dashboard, today) and `operations-ui.js` (schedule and the booking dialogs); calculations live in `PemaCRM` and `PemaOps` (`operations-data.js`).
- `crm-ui.js › today()` with the doctor projection: `all` is filtered to `a.doctor === PemaStaff.current().doctor` (BS. Mai = D1); the tile "Phát sinh hóa đơn hôm nay" is skipped when the role is doctor, so the stat row has 8 tiles (Tổng lịch, Đã đến, six status buttons).
- Toolbar (search, status, doctor filters), table and pagination are the same as WB3; only the rows differ (8 appointments of BS. Mai). The "Bác sĩ" filter stays editable here (unlike the schedule, WB11).
- Inventory note: Doctor projection: only the doctor's own appointments, and the tile "Phát sinh hóa đơn hôm nay" is not drawn (8 tiles instead of 9).
- Page key `today` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `doctor-mai`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"today\"]"}; it must show `#crm-today-search`.

## Business rules
- Reception buttons per row: "Check-in" and "Vắng" for Chưa đến and Đã xác nhận rows; "Mời vào phòng" after check-in; "Mở 360" for the other statuses.

## Differences from the app design
- App I2 also shows the signed-in role's list; the web subtitle says "dữ liệu tổng hợp 20/09/2026", the app "22/09/2026".
- Canvas: the eight reception tiles are drawn in two rows of four, as WB3 does; the old page has one row of eight.

## Gotchas
- The demo day is fixed: 2026-09-20 09:00 (`DAY` in `operations-data.js` and `crm-automation.js`). Dates before that day cannot be booked.
- Money is not hidden for doctors: the column "Giá lịch dự kiến" still shows each appointment price; only the invoice total tile is removed.

## Web canvas
- Frames: 1440x900 (inventory: 1440x900); screen label `WB10 · Hôm nay · Bác sĩ`.
- Canvas note: Web › today (tài khoản bác sĩ) · chỉ hiện lịch của chính bác sĩ (8 lịch của BS. Mai) và không vẽ ô "Phát sinh hóa đơn hôm nay" (8 ô thay vì 9); bộ lọc "Bác sĩ" vẫn sửa được; app I2 không có lọc theo bác sĩ; tên và số liệu là dữ liệu tổng hợp
